# honeybadger_integration_backlog (Resource)

A notification integration



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) The type's settings, listed per type in [Integration types](https://docs.honeybadger.io/api/v3/integrations/types/). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `project_id` (String) Project public ID

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether to use the integration. An OAuth integration that isn't `connected` sends nothing until it is.
- `alarm_alert_ids` (Set of String) IDs of alarms whose alert events this integration receives. Send null or [] to clear. A set; order is ignored and duplicates are dropped.
- `alarm_ok_ids` (Set of String) IDs of alarms whose recovery events this integration receives. Send null or [] to clear. A set; order is ignored and duplicates are dropped.
- `all_check_ins` (Boolean) Follow every check-in in the project, including ones added later. When true, check_in_ids must be empty or left out, and reads return []. Sending a non-empty check_in_ids turns it off. With it off and check_in_ids empty, the integration gets no check-in events.
- `all_sites` (Boolean) Follow every site in the project, including ones added later. When true, site_ids must be empty or left out, and reads return []. Sending a non-empty site_ids turns it off. With it off and site_ids empty, the integration gets no up or down events.
- `check_in_ids` (Set of String) Specific check-ins whose events this integration receives. An empty list turns check-in notifications off unless all_check_ins is true; a non-empty list with all_check_ins: true is 422. An ID that isn't one of this project's check-ins fails the request with 422. Send null or [] to clear. A set; order is ignored and duplicates are dropped.
- `events` (Set of String) Left out or null: `occurred`, `resolved`, and `unresolved`, less any the plan doesn't include. Removing it from config keeps the current value.
- `excluded_environments` (Set of String) Errors from these environments never notify through this integration. Takes precedence over included_environments. Names are stored as given, so an environment can be excluded before it first reports. Send null or [] to clear. Applies only on plans with environment settings; changing it on other plans is 403 feature_unavailable. Reads return what's stored. A set; order is ignored and duplicates are dropped.
- `filters` (Attributes List) An ordered list. Each event that has a filter notifies only for errors matching its query. Replaces the stored filters; send [] or null to clear. Applies only on plans with integration filters; changing it on other plans is 403 feature_unavailable. Reads return what's stored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `included_environments` (Set of String) When non-empty, only errors from these environments notify through this integration, including environments that haven't reported yet. Empty means every environment not excluded. Send null or [] to clear. Applies only on plans with environment settings; changing it on other plans is 403 feature_unavailable. Reads return what's stored. A set; order is ignored and duplicates are dropped.
- `notification_limit` (Number) Maximum notifications in a 10-minute window before flood control.
- `rate` (String) Rate threshold period (e.g. min, hour).
- `site_ids` (Set of String) Specific sites whose up and down events this integration receives. An empty list turns site notifications off unless all_sites is true; a non-empty list with all_sites: true is 422. An ID that isn't one of this project's sites fails the request with 422. Send null or [] to clear. A set; order is ignored and duplicates are dropped.
- `threshold` (Number) Number of occurrences before rate_exceeded fires.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the channel was created
- `id` (String) Unique identifier
- `links` (Attributes) Links into the Honeybadger web UI (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Your Backlog API key (generate one in Personal Settings > API). Never returned. Leave it out of an update to keep it.
- `backlog_project_id` (String) The Backlog project to create issues in. The web UI loads the choices from the connected account. Through the API, send the value itself, as that service's API returns it.
- `issue_type_id` (String) The type of issue to create. The web UI loads the choices from the connected account. Through the API, send the value itself, as that service's API returns it.
- `priority_id` (String) The priority level for new issues. The web UI loads the choices from the connected account. Through the API, send the value itself, as that service's API returns it.
- `reopen_status_id` (String) The status to use when unresolving errors. The web UI loads the choices from the connected account. Through the API, send the value itself, as that service's API returns it.
- `resolve_status_id` (String) The status to use when resolving errors. The web UI loads the choices from the connected account. Through the API, send the value itself, as that service's API returns it.
- `space_url` (String) Your Backlog space URL (e.g., https://example.backlog.com or https://example.backlog.jp).

Optional:

- `description_format` (String)
- `enable_webhook` (Boolean) When enabled Honeybadger will create a webhook in Backlog to sync issue status changes back to Honeybadger.
- `label` (String) Optional label to show in the integrations list.
- `subject_format` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `event` (String) An event name, or `all` for every event.
- `query` (String) An error search query, as in the Errors search box.


<a id="nestedatt--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `links`

Read-Only:

- `web` (String) Absolute URL of this resource's page in the Honeybadger web UI, on the web UI's host rather than the API's. For a project provisioned through Heroku, error, notice and comment links go through Heroku's single sign-on, on Heroku's host.
